title: Was Stalin Necessary? Counterfactual Evidence on Soviet Growth
hypothesis: Observed Russian-core growth after 1928 exceeds admissible non-Stalinist counterfactual (median and ASCF-90 frontier) from mid-1930s onward; broader SUN does not exceed ASCF-90; hostile stress frontier not exceeded.
data_sources: Global Macro Database Russian-core GDP and GDP-per-capita
Maddison Project Database 2023 RUS and SUN GDP-per-capita
CIA/RAND Soviet national accounts GNP sector and end-use
sample: Long-run historical panels for Russia/Soviet Union (RUS and SUN) and donor pool. Prewar trend estimation 1900-1913. Recovery-gap persistence estimated 1921-1928. Normalization 1928=100. Principal endpoint 1938, sensitivity endpoints 1933,1934,1936,1940. Triangulation 1928-1937,1937-1940,1928-1954.
method: 1. Normalize every observed and counterfactual log-output path to 1928=100 via y1928=y1929-g1929 and 100*exp(y_t-y1928).

2. Estimate prewar log-linear trend 1900-1913 for Russia. Define recovery gap G_t = potential - observed log output per capita. Estimate annual gap persistence rho from 1921-1928 gap ratios. Parameter: prewar window 1900-1913.

3. Build bootstrap recovery-gap NEP counterfactual: for each draw resample prewar trend residual and gap-closure ratio residual, compute log Y_NEP_t = log Y_potential_t - G_1928 * rho^(t-1928). Parameter: bootstrap draws 1000s (not stated exact number - kept as parameter).

4. Estimate statistical counterfactuals: SCM (convex nonnegative weights sum to one), NNLS-SCM, Augmented SCM with ridge bias correction, Synthetic DiD with unit+time weights, Generalized Synthetic Control with interactive fixed effects/PCA ridge, Matrix Completion with nuclear-norm/low-rank SVD. Retained as prediction benchmarks: ridge, Bayesian ridge, elastic net, Huber robust, PLS, random forest, extra trees, gradient boosting, kNN, super learner. Parameter: ridge penalties, cross-validation folds as method inputs.

5. Compute admissible frontiers: Donor p75 frontier and ASCF median (ASCF-50) and ASCF-90 primary frontier. Stress frontiers: Donor p90 hostile upper bound, NEP uncapped stress, population denominator stress. Parameter: percentiles p75, p90.

6. Compute scorecard margins = 100*(observed - frontier)/frontier for each Source{Treated} x Endpoint{1933,1934,1936,1938,1940} x Frontier{ASCF-50,ASCF-90,Stress-90}. Grade B = observed > ASCF-90 and < Stress-90; Grade C = observed > ASCF-50 and < ASCF-90.
7. Diagnostics: pre-treatment RMSE, pre-treatment correlation, conformal trajectory bands (outside band indicator).
8. Robustness: largest SCM donor weights (endpoint 1940), leave-one-donor-out (27 donors remaining), random 75% donor subpools. Parameter: 75% subpool fraction.

9. Falsification: spatial placebos reassign treatment to donor units with same estimator, compute effect, exact two-sided rank p = rank/(N+1) and post/pre RMSPE ratio. Parameter: 8 effective placebo units. Fake treatment origins at 1905,1913,1921,1924,1926 with horizons 12,12,7,4,2. Recovery placebos on Greece, Belgium, South Africa, Venezuela (figure only, values not printed - omitted as test).
10. Triangulation: CIA/RAND average annual GNP growth 1928-37, 1937-40, 1928-54 estimates A/B and end-use composition.
